svg.title: ledger in a Claude Code session: from /ledger:go to a pull request
svg.desc: A terminal running Claude Code with the ledger tool. You type /ledger:go offline-queue-loss. The agent moves into the worktree, loads the ledger and proposes a plan: 1. a test that kills the app during a sync, 2. save each item to disk before sending it, 3. delete an item only after the server confirms it. You type yes; the plan is written to the ledger. Helper agents work: the researcher finds the cause, the new test fails and reproduces the bug, the implementer writes the fix, 14 tests pass, the reviewer accepts. The agent says: Clear point. Ledger updated. Type /ledger:next to continue. You type /ledger:next; the screen clears and a fresh session loads the ledger at step 3 of 3, finishes it, and asks to commit and open a PR. You type yes, and PR #42 opens.

g.text: Ledger loaded — next: write the plan
1. A test that kills the app during a sync
2. Save each item to disk before sending it
3. Delete an item only after the server confirms it
1 failing — the test reproduces the bug
Clear point. Ledger updated. Type /ledger:next to continue.
Fresh session — ledger loaded, step 3 of 3
All steps done. Commit and open a PR?
